data.name: Graham
data.long_meaning: The name Graham has a contested origin. Some sources claim it is derived from the Greek name Gramos, meaning 'grain'. Others suggest it is from the Hebrew name Gragam, which translates to 'son of the exile'. Both origins have been used in Christian traditions, and the name carries symbolism of perseverance and resilience in the face of adversity.
